name: dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return
title: Return Policy Extension
description: Defines the `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return` policy type on the core `policies[]` primitive, enabling businesses to advertise return terms across one or more supported capabilities (catalog, cart, checkout, and order).

final_sale.description: When `true`, the covered items cannot be returned. When `false` or omitted, the items are returnable subject to the other fields.

window.title: Return Window
window.description: Return window as a policy statement. Omit for an unlimited or unstated window.

days.description: Length of the return window in whole days from `anchor`.

anchor.description: Event `days` is measured from. Well-known values: `delivered`, `purchased`, `shipped`, `fulfilled`.

supported_resolutions.description: Accepted return outcomes, as an unordered set. Well-known values: `original_payment_method`, `store_credit`, `gift_card`, `exchange`, `replacement`.

methods.description: Permitted return channels and the logistics cost of each.

restocking_fee.title: Restocking Fee
restocking_fee.description: A refund deduction applied regardless of return channel. Provide `percentage_bps`, `amount`, or both.

percentage_bps.description: Restocking fee in basis points of the item price (e.g., `1500` = 15%).

amount.description: Restocking fee as a flat charge in ISO 4217 minor units.

fee.title: Return Method Fee
fee.description: Logistics cost of using a return channel. Open vocabulary.

fixed_fee.title: Fixed Fee Return Method Fee
fixed_fee.description: Fixed logistics fee charged for a return channel.

amount.description: Flat channel fee in ISO 4217 minor units. Required when type is fixed_fee.

return_method.title: Return Method
return_method.description: A return channel and its logistics cost.

fee.description: Logistics cost of using this channel.

return_policy.title: Return Policy
return_policy.description: A return policy statement with type `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return`.

policies_item.description: A `policies[]` entry; validates against `return_policy` when `type` is `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return`.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with return policy (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with return policy (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).
